title: Validate comment and issue reaction responses with schemas
recorded_defect: CLAUDE.md, API Compatibility: 'Do not cast network JSON to T' and 'include a malformed-response test'. packages/core/api/client.ts addReaction and addIssueReaction return this.fetch(...) cast to Reaction and IssueReaction with no validation.
trial_role: Trial 3, task 3. New schemas for response types whose Go structs have to be read field by field, which is where the server-contract check applies.
objective:
packages/core/api/client.ts has two methods that trust the server response without validation: addReaction (typed Reaction) and addIssueReaction (typed IssueReaction). The repository rule in CLAUDE.md (API Compatibility) requires endpoint responses consumed by UI logic to pass through a zod schema, with a malformed-response test.

Read the Go handlers for POST /api/comments/{id}/reactions and POST /api/issues/{id}/reactions and the exact structs they serialise, including every json tag. Write schemas in packages/core/api/schemas.ts that accept everything the server can legitimately send and reject what it cannot. Read how callers use the returned reaction and decide what a malformed response must do. Do not change any other method.

Write tests at exactly packages/core/api/reaction-responses.test.ts covering a well-formed response and a malformed response for each method.
